title: John Deere S100 42-Inch 17.5 HP Gas Riding Lawn Tractor Hydrostatic Transmission
description:
The
John Deere
S100 Riding Lawn Tractor is designed to deliver dependable performance, smooth handling, and trusted durability for residential lawn care. Built with John Deere quality and comfort in mind, this riding mower provides efficient cutting performance for homeowners maintaining medium to large lawns.
Powered by a reliable 17.5 HP single-cylinder engine, the S100 offers consistent power for mowing, mulching, and bagging applications while delivering fuel-efficient operation. The Kanzaki® Tuff Torq hydrostatic transmission allows smooth speed and direction control using easy-to-operate foot pedals, eliminating the need for manual shifting.
The durable 42-inch Edge™ mower deck is constructed from reinforced stamped steel and engineered to provide a clean, even cut across a variety of grass conditions. The 7-position cutting height adjustment allows users to select cutting heights ranging from 1.5 to 4 inches for customized lawn appearance.
Designed for operator comfort, the S100 features a 10-position adjustable low-back seat, wide footrests with anti-vibration mats, and ergonomic controls for reduced fatigue during extended mowing sessions. The heavy-duty one-piece welded 12-gauge steel frame and cast-iron front axle provide enhanced strength, stability, and long-term durability.
The S100 is also compatible with a variety of optional John Deere accessories, including rear baggers, mulch kits, sun canopies, snow blowers, and front blades, making it a versatile year-round lawn and property maintenance solution.
Combining reliable performance, user-friendly operation, and durable construction, the John Deere S100 Riding Lawn Tractor is built to handle residential lawn care with efficiency and confidence.
Key Specifications:
Brand: John Deere
Model: S100
Product Type: Gas Riding Lawn Tractor
Engine Power: 17.5 HP Single-Cylinder Engine
Fuel Type: Gas

Cutting Height Range: 1.5″ – 4″

Compatible Attachments: Baggers, Mulch Kits, Snow Blowers, Front Blades, Sun Canopies
